initialSymptom: Brokered ECB route returned 503 temporarily_unavailable with blocker Invalid IP address: undefined while independent direct ECB HTTPS data and policy requests both returned HTTP 200.
rootCause: Node24 automatic address-family selection interacted with Velmère single-address DNS-pinned custom lookup. The old callback contract was intentionally single-address; automatic multi-address selection caused the undefined-IP dial path.

p69r1FailedRepair.description: First repair added autoSelectFamily:false directly in the https.request object literal. Runtime intent was correct but the repository-pinned Node type declaration did not expose that property, so semantic TypeScript failed and the attempt received zero credit.

finalRepair.rootCause: Node24 automatic address-family selection is incompatible with the intentionally single-address custom pinned lookup path and produced Invalid IP address: undefined, while direct ECB HTTPS was reachable.
finalRepair.securityBoundary: No DNS pinning, public-IP validation, redirect, TLS, allow-list or host-policy control was removed or weakened.

truthBoundary: This is a compatibility/security transport repair. It does not broaden allowed hosts or relax SSRF protections and grants no full product/release credit.
